description: Which one-press fix solves this computer problem? Give the problem in the user's own words (for example: my wifi keeps dropping, pc is slow, no sound). problem is required. system is optional (windows, macos, linux, android, ios): pass it when the user said which device they use, and the answer adds what the fix does on that system. Returns up to 3 fixes, best first, each with the page to open; there the user presses Fix it. Do not invent a fix name: call this.

problem.description: The problem in plain words. Example: bluetooth keeps disconnecting

name: find_fix
title: Find the fix for a computer problem
